newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol retail share price around 5,803 ptas.
newsitem.headline: Repsol retail share price around 5,803 ptas.

text.p: The price at which Repsol shares are likely be sold to the Spanish public will be 5,803 pesetas, on the basis of the share prospectus, as dealers do not expect the institutional price to fall beneath this level.
This price is the result of applying a four percent discount to the average weighted price as traded on the Madrid bourse today, which was 6,045 pesetas, according to the stock market authorities.

The prospectus states that the price for the retail tranche of this month's share offer will be the cheapest of three; the average weighted price of listed stock today with a four percent discount, the ceiling price set for the retail tranche on April 21 of 6,327 pesetas or the price set for the institutional tranche.
Today's average weighted price minus four percent is lower than the 6,327 peseta ceiling.

The third reference, the institutional price, will be set after Wall Street closes on the basis of the stock's traded price in Madrid and/or on the New York Stock Exchange, according to the prospectus. Dealers said they did not expect it to undercut the average weighted price.
In the last two Repsol placements, the institutional price coincided with the Madrid closing price.
State holding company SEPI will announce the final price for the offer later tonight.
